description: Feudal Aggro with Raider Elephants supported by a Healer Elephant. Super fast aggro that bullies the opponent into idling vills lest you trample them. Follow with Archers to deal with Spearmen.
name: Feudal Aggro with Raider and Healer Elephants
author: Eldritch

notes: Queue @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@an send all @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ the second new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build @building_economy/house.webp@ first
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 more @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up

Move @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and 1 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ there until 4
Build @building_military/stable.webp@ with the 4 age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ then go back to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Produce 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to enemy base to deny resources
Produce 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ and send to assist your 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
Once at 16 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and produce a @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ if necessary

Once you have 2 @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and 1 @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ produce 2 more @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ an 1 more @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if opponent goes @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

name: 2 tc fort build feudal into raider elephants etc season 12
author: PeNDraGoN

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ , build 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ instantly and use them to scout for sheep left and right

@resource/rally.webp@2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to  @resource/resource_gold.webp@ build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 1st civ (make sure this is a good place for fort later, you surround the fort with farms and houses  then change @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Bring @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ back to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ for 50 ish seconds

On 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@  move 2  @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_gold.webp@  and 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@  to @resource/resource_stone.webp@and also move the @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@
move other @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ line and drop of its @resource/sheep.webp@

on age up use 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   from  @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@   @resource/rally.webp@from  @building_economy/town-center.webp@to age up with @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ 2nd @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ (TOTAL OF 5)

rally @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ till 8  move 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@  from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ ( you want 4 on food)

when age up is complete take 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@   and move to @resource/sheep.webp@  then take 1 other @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and move to build @building_economy/house.webp@  at 1st @building_economy/house.webp@ rally 2nd house @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build  @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ with @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@(step below)

take 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near @building_economy/house.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ total of 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ building it

at around 7 mins to 7-30 build @building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/stable.webp@  depending on whats best, @building_military/barracks.webp@ into  @building_military/stable.webp@    vs @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ civs
Age up with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ with @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ (@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ can be playable)

Keep mining @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until there is 320 stone remaining then send @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and add 2 more @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@
Produce army to counter ennemy civ and produce @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@. Remacro for 7 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@to@resource/resource_stone.webp@. When @age/age_2.webp@ completes move the 3 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@to@resource/resource_stone.webp@

Gather @resource/resource_stone.webp@ until 320 remaining so you have enough to fully upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@@ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@. Move to @resource/resource_wood.webp@@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@ depending on enemy counters. Continually produce @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.

description: See build video for very useful advice
name: Fast 2TC + Tughlaq Fort Build (2026)
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ go to @resource/berrybush.webp@ with @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ & 2 go to @resource/sheep.webp@. You also want to spawn a 2nd @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to collect sheep around base and go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Take 4 @resource/sheep.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ and go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (make sure you have all 3)
2 age-up @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ will build the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ inbetween 2nd TC placement and Main TC with 8 tiles space. (see video for placement guidance here)

470/1200 left in @resource/resource_stone.webp@mine pull all @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ away and walk towards @resource/resource_gold.webp@and build @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Afterwards scout opponent and make units or go FC if they also boom.

6 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ go to @resource/berrybush.webp@ with @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@. You also want to spawn a 2nd @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ to collect sheep around base and go to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Queue @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ & macro villagers correctly and @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@ (see vill split on the left side of this build order)

Make first production buildings now. You want to scout and go counter units. If no units to counter, default to @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ + @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ spam

Start attacking opponent very aggressively when you get the first units out, and get blacksmith techs and push. You can find feudal dmg and try to win there, or go for a timing attack in early castle age.
train 2 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ 1 for @resource/resource_gold.webp@ / 1 to explore around to get @resource/sheep.webp@

description: Transcripted from Corvinus1's video for me to understand
name: Corvinus' Tower of victory+2TC+Fort BOOM - CookieRexYum
author: CookieRexYum

notes: 6 from @resource/berrybush.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ bring @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ send rest from berry to sheep
Make 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@or@resource/deer.webp@ with 10 from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Now go production (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@+@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@) then @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@ and WIN!
